name: Guy in a Box Killing Things Simulator
summary:
Guy In A Box Killing Things Simulator is a fast-ish-paced first-person shooter where you play as a bean. Battle bean enemies, upgrade your abilities, and survive as long as possible.

Collect powerful upgrades during your run to become stronger and see how long you can stay alive against your bean foes.
